test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

The viable of life / depends on a pair / of conflicting realities.
solution:
The correct answer is '**The viable of life**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**The viable of life**" contains an incorrect usage of the word "**viable**."
 
• "**Viable**" is an adjective, meaning capable of working successfully or feasible.
 
• The correct term to use in this context is "**viability**," which is the noun form of "**viable**."
 
• The corrected phrase should read "**The viability of life**."

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 3**’

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The viability of life / depends on a pair / of conflicting realities.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **depends on a pair**: This part of the sentence is correct. It correctly uses "depends" as the verb and "on a pair" as the prepositional phrase.
 
• **No error**: This option is incorrect because the phrase "The viable of life" contains an error.
 
• **of conflicting realities**: This part of the sentence is correct. It correctly uses the preposition "of" followed by the plural noun "conflicting realities."
